data.title: The Iraq Visa Guide
data.description: Everything a traveller needs before landing.
data.content:
Before you fly

Most nationalities can now obtain a visa on arrival, but the paperwork still matters: a passport valid for six months, a confirmed hotel booking, and the entry fee in cash.

This guide walks the counters of Baghdad International step by step.

data.title: Top Ten Baghdad Landmarks
data.description: A walking guide to the capital between two rivers.
data.content:
The city between two rivers

From the Abbasid palace to Mutanabbi street, Baghdad rewards the patient walker. Start at the old book market, cross Al-Shuhada bridge at sunset, and finish with masgouf on Abu Nuwas corniche.

Our local guides pick the ten stops no first visit should miss.

data.title: About us
data.content:
We are a travel desk built for the Kingdom: visas, stays, tours and transfers booked from one account, priced in your currency and confirmed before you pay the balance.

Every listing on this platform is operated by a verified partner. We hold the booking with the operator, collect the payment on their behalf and stay in the conversation until the trip is over.

Our support desk answers in Arabic and English, seven days a week, from inside the app.

envelope.status: bool — true on success, false on failure
envelope.code: string — one of codes[], maps 1:1 to the HTTP status
envelope.message: string — one of messages[], generic and reusable across endpoints
envelope.data: object|array|null — the payload; collections put the items array here
envelope.reason: string — one of the keys of reasons{}, present on failures only
envelope.money: object — {amount, currency, display:{amount, currency}}; amount is the stored value in its own currency, display is the same value in the X-Currency the viewer asked for; a row-level currency key beside a money object is the viewer currency
envelope.errors: object|null — field-level map {field: [messages]} on validation/business failures
envelope.meta: object — pagination and response extensions, never business data

reasons.invalid_state: operation not valid in the current state
reasons.price_changed: the price changed, request a new quote
reasons.requote_required: the offer changed, request a new quote
reasons.currency_unavailable: the currency is unavailable right now
reasons.in_flight: a matching request is already in flight
reasons.key_reused: this idempotency key was already used with a different request

starts_at.note: required when the catalog tracks availability, inside the booking window

adults.note: bounded by the covering price plan occupancy

children.note: bounded by the covering price plan occupancy

pets.note: refused when a catalog rule excludes pets

ends_at.note: checkout; the price multiplies by the nights between

applicants.note: one element per traveller; when present the quantity derives from its length

applicants.*.nationality.note: judged by the listing nationality rules

applicants.*.residency.note: judged by the listing residency rules

applicants.note: one element per insured person; the quantity derives from its length

applicants.*.nationality.note: judged by the listing nationality rules

applicants.*.residency.note: judged by the listing residency rules

starts_at.note: the appointment start; one of the published slots when the catalog publishes hours, any open day otherwise; the end derives from the catalog duration (or appointment_minutes)

budgets.seat: tenant + account for a bearer, tenant + address for a guest — a bucket never crosses a tenant

fronts.value: Basic base64(key:secret) — a credential its tenant admin issued with the scope below
fronts.certifies: the address of the visitor the front names — never an actor, a role or a permission
fronts.origin: server side only — both headers are refused to a browser by the preflight

txt.content: free text, e.g. a verification token

srv.content: weight port target, e.g. 5 5223 sip.example.com — priority required

pagination.sidebar: object — the aggregates this request asked for, echoed back
pagination.supports: object — {filters,sorts,sortable,facets,stats,metrics,groups,series} the keys this surface answers; sortable maps each sort to the column it orders

aggregates.facets: object — {dimension: {value: hits}}, each dimension self-excluding so the sidebar keeps its other choices
aggregates.stats: object — {dimension: {min,max,avg,sum}} bounds, money as exact decimal strings
aggregates.metrics: object — {alias: value} over the WHOLE filtered set
aggregates.groups: object — {dimension: [{value, ...metrics}]} the same metrics pivoted per dimension value

query.query: free text — matched over the columns and the translations search index
query.limit: rows per page, clamped to context.search.max_limit
query.ids[]: one id or a list of them
query.fields[]: return only these keys of each rendered row — id always rides
query.filters[key]: one entry per meta.supports.filters key — every key takes a single value OR a list; a raw column@operator pair is still accepted
query.aggregates[]: relation tallies beside each row — [relation, count|sum|avg|min|max|exists, column, alias?] per entry
query.facets[]: count these dimensions beside the page, each self-excluding
query.stats[]: bound these dimensions beside the page (min · max · avg · sum)
query.metrics[]: kind:key measures over the WHOLE filtered set
query.groups[]: pivot those metrics per dimension value
query.ranges: edges per faceted dimension — turns its counts into brackets
query.window: from,to for the series instead of its default window
query.size: how many values a group or facet returns
query.view: rendition — tiny answers the card facts only (info · geo brief · brief), full is the default

idempotency_conflict.message: a matching request is already in flight

idempotency: a matching request is already in flight
